correctness.rationale: Direct exact hypergeometric factorial moments prove Delta_i=kappa(2i-N) under r_n=n(N-1)/(N-n). Detailed balance and reflection give symmetric stationary law; consecutive ratios on the upper half vary strictly in selection strength with sign kappa. Grouping reflected states yields strict monotone likelihood-ratio comparison for each pair of attainable deviations; the variance and heterozygosity inequalities are immediate. All boundaries and the odd-N central edge are treated separately. Independent exact-rational finite checker passed 3432 payoff identities, 2376 stationary checks and 14139 strict-order/equality checks; all-parameter conclusion rests on the proof.

value.rationale: A mathematically and behaviorally natural balanced-return regime in a canonical nonlinear n-person cooperation model admits a complete, strict finite-population stationary comparison for every selection intensity and every strictly positive uniform-exploration rate. The result orders every polarization tail, not only a plotted mode or average, and proves a robust sign reversal between synergy and discounting. It supplies useful distributional comparative statics beyond deterministic equilibria while acknowledging reliance on classical birth-death techniques and an exact balance restriction.
